goal: A tool that improves the SEO of any web page I give it: read the page from the internet, tell me what holds it back in search, and give me the better title, description, headings and opening text, each change with its reason. Start with https://sankalpasawa.github.io/sutra/
why: founder 2026-09-29 ~17:05: 'I want to build out a tool which improves the SEO of pages. Use the Human Simulation program to do it.' A fresh organisation from the app's own sheet; the tool is whatever the department's own functions shape from these words (an engine that reads a page, judges it, files the changes), never a thing the session builds by hand. The person gives a page, not facts. Runs on Beta 2.306.16-desktop (run 3's fixes 34-46: sutra 5c0b518a).

outcomes.expect: Page SEO in the tree with its Root, On, from the New organisation sheet
one department under Root after one Stamp, named for the tool, of a kind that fits words that are not a website

verify.check: a department under the Root; its kind

outcomes.expect: the department says its words need the internet, which no engine of its own reaches; Adaptation shapes one and the engine ask follows; meanwhile nothing is made from an unread page and the chat says the line waits for the stamp

verify.check: 'no engine of mine reaches the internet yet'; an ask of kind engine; 'The line waits for your stamp on <engine>'; no Result before the stamp

outcomes.expect: after the Stamp the engine is on the Map, first in the line, and runs at once on the page; its reading is filed and the chat says '<name> v1 is filed.' with a button named for it

verify.check: engines[0] is the new one; an artifact of its name with v1

outcomes.expect: what the department files for the page is what holds it back in search and the better title, description, headings and opening text, each with its reason; nothing invented about the page

verify.check: a title, a description, headings, opening text, reasons; the page's own words quoted

outcomes.expect: a second page given in the chat gets its own reading and its own report; the first page's report is not lost

verify.check: the engine's artifact v2 and the Result v2; v1 still readable

variances.do: say a rule: Never change what a page claims, only how it says it. Stamp it.
variances.expect: the rule is asked for as a rule ('A rule, as understood: ...'), and stamped it is on the record's rules; no search runs for it

verify.check: rules[] has it; the engine's versions unchanged

variances.do: ask: Which of your changes matters most?
variances.expect: an answer from the record in the chat, not a new run

verify.check: a turn word answer; no new Result version

variances.do: say: Do the second page first from now on.
variances.expect: the words in Priority's chat at once and the person stays there; what came of them lands in that chat too

verify.check: a turn src Owner with the words; the tells of its chain

variances.do: open Identity's Chat, then Adaptation's, then Identity's again
variances.expect: each its own existing chat; nothing starts, nothing lost

verify.check: the same turns on the second open

variances.do: press Stop while the engine reads a page; Start again
variances.expect: Stopped and Started are turns; the run resumes; one version
